research_question: Does additional Stage2 training improve the previously completed Stage1 plus residual-Adapter planner on the same development panel?
ssl_execution: One world clip on every second planning microbatch, with twice the per-microbatch SSL weight; global mean and eight clips per optimizer update preserved.
learning_rate_extension: Preserve the completed optimizer learning rates (LPWM approximately1e-6, planner approximately3e-5) as constants; do not restart warmup or silently recompute a longer cosine schedule.
comparison_scope: Same75297 training scenes,1024 planning development scenes/1021 valid scores and256 world clips. Stage1/native LPWM frozen; adapters/planner/command continue learning; no direct object GT. Not navtest.
execution_caveat: Microbatch regrouping changes dropout and SSL sample grouping; effective batches and objectives are retained, but the continuation is not bitwise equivalent to the historical batch8 run.
